prompt: Summarize this in one sentence: A small community library extended its hours on two evenings each week after a survey found that many residents could not visit during standard work hours. After three months, evening visits increased, while total weekly visits stayed about the same.

Extract the name, appointment date, time, and location from this note. Return only valid JSON with those four keys: 'Maya Chen is booked with Dr. Ortiz at North Clinic for 3:30 PM on November 12, 2026.'

A team has a $240 monthly API budget. It spent $78 in week one and $64 in week two. If spending in each of the remaining two weeks is 15% higher than week two, what will the month-end total be, and how much budget remains? Show the arithmetic.

Compare these options for a small team running 50,000 short text requests monthly: Model A costs $0.20 per million input tokens and $0.80 per million output tokens with 400 ms average latency; Model B costs $1.00 and $4.00 respectively with 250 ms latency. Explain the cost-latency tradeoff and give one condition under which B could be preferable.
Write a Python function that takes a list of integers and returns the second-largest distinct value. Raise ValueError if fewer than two distinct values exist. Include a short example call.

Classify the customer message as positive, neutral, or negative, and give one short reason: 'The delivery arrived two days late. Support was polite and refunded the shipping fee, but I needed the item for the event.'
Rewrite this as a polite, concise email sentence without changing its meaning: 'You still haven't sent the numbers, and I can't finish the report until you do.'
Explain the difference between input tokens and output tokens in an LLM API bill to a software engineering intern. Use a short concrete example.
Give a five-step plan for comparing two text-generation models on the same support-ticket dataset. Include at least one quality measure, one cost measure, and one latency measure.
